title: HydroGo content type
description: One file in content-types/*.yaml. In VS Code with the YAML extension, add `# yaml-language-server: $schema=<path or URL to this file>` as the first line for completion and validation.

title_field.description: Field id shown as the record title.

drafts.description: Records have a draft/published status; the public API returns only published ones.

permissions.description: Guard this type with its own permissions instead of admin.content.read/write. Admins hold every permission; others get a named one through a per-user override.

access.description: Row access in the admin API: users without the all permission see and change only records whose owner text field holds their e-mail address; they become the owner of what they create. Public reads are unaffected.

rules.description: Validation and lock rules; conditions use the expression language (comparisons, && || !, 'text', true, false, empty(field), arithmetic).

assert.description: Every saved record (for which when holds) must satisfy it.

readonly.description: A stored record for which when holds cannot be edited or deleted.

states.description: State machine on a select field: new records start in initial and move only through transitions (POST .../{id}/state).

permission.description: Permission the caller needs, e.g. invoice.approve (admins have every permission).

revisions.description: Keep the last 50 saved versions of each record. Required when any field is localized.

list.description: Show as a sortable column in the admin list.

to.description: Target content type id of a relation field.

many.description: A relation field holding several records.

permission.description: Only holders of this permission see or change the field (admins always do). Not with required, unique, searchable, localized or sequence; the type cannot be public.

filterable.description: text, textarea, select, number, boolean, date, datetime and single relation fields.

localized.description: One value per site locale (text, textarea, richtext, media).

decimals.description: Number fields: fixed decimal places (money: 2). Values with more places are rejected, never rounded.

computed.description: Number fields with decimals: an expression over number fields declared earlier, calculated on every save (+ - * /, parentheses, abs, min, max, round(x, places)).

sequence.description: Text fields: number new records without gaps.

prefix.description: May contain {yyyy}, {yy} and {mm}; the counter restarts when the expanded prefix changes.
